steps.instruction: Use your own GameCube USA GC6E01 ISO or CISO.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: This is a developer route. Use tools/disc.py to convert and check your own GC6E01 image, then scripts/recompile.sh with DolRecomp. The project documents native Windows and Android hosts, but this guide does not establish a ready-made release package.
